utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still on for today. I’m heading over soon and will let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — text me if it slips, will you?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the details of the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the repair drive details yet, Hana—if you send me the date, time, and location, I’ll help you keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Opal. I’ll send the date, time, and location once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep things moving. What’s the first item you want me to line up?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll join a bit late, but I can help once I get there—maybe start with the tools and a quick list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll start a tools list and a quick repair checklist so we can hit the ground running when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s coming together nicely—people are sorting tools, parts, and a few volunteers to help with the bigger fixes. If you’ve got a wrench or a free hour, we can use both.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good—I can probably spare an hour and I might have a wrench to lend. What should I bring first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in—what’s the first repair you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Leo. If you can start with the loose front gate, that would help me most.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check the front gate first and tighten whatever’s loose.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep folks posted about the repair drive and repeat the plan as it comes together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an ear out and can lend a hand if anything needs repeating.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan so everyone stays in the loop, and I’ll let you know if we need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli — I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, and I’d love for you to come by. If you want, I can send you the details and time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Quinn. Send me the details and time, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details and time right over. It’d be great to see you there if you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and parts all morning. If you need anything fixed, now’s a pretty good time to ask around.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! I might bring over that squeaky chair and ask if anyone’s got a wrench for it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be a good one to bring by — they’ve got a pretty helpful little crowd over there today. If you swing through, I bet someone can quiet that chair right down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times—what day is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps—I'm still waiting on the exact day and time so I can make sure the pickup plan fits. If you hear back first, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the day and time, and I can help fit the pickup plan around school either way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, thanks for the update—how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s moving along okay so far—got a few things sorted and I’m still checking on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear—sounds like you’re making progress. Let me know if you need anything while you’re checking on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered, but I can help if you need me to bring something by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah. If you can bring any spare tools or screws, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll check my toolbox and bring over any spare screws or useful tools I can find.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get a date yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I’m checking the supply list and can pin one down soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you let me know as soon as it’s set? I can help with supplies if needed.
